title: Object hidden behind a container
description:
Layout-quality rule — a layout object lies completely within the bounds of a portal, tab control or slide control that is drawn in front of it. The object is covered in Browse mode and cannot be clicked — usually a stacking-order accident.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Hidden Object (Behind Container)" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: An object fully covered by a portal, tab or slide control that is drawn later in the stacking order is invisible and unclickable in Browse mode — dead weight that still renders and evaluates.
rule.remediation: Bring the object in front of the container, move it elsewhere, or delete it if it is a leftover.
